_what: Every check this curation ran, with numbers. Nothing is emitted into data/; see DECISIONS.md.

paper.proposed_Experiment_ID: YZ_2024 -- ALREADY TAKEN by PMID 38082180. See DECISIONS.md D-3.

P1_weight_percentages_sum_to_100._what: Five percentages printed INDEPENDENTLY per row (helper, MC3, cholesterol, DMG-PEG, pDNA). None is a stated balance, so this is a real transcription check, not a tautology.

P2_prose_grouping_Sec_3_3._what: The paper names six formulations that 'all achieved transfection levels exceeding 5 x 10^4 photons/s'. A prose grouping is a threshold claim on a quantity we measured independently.
P2_prose_grouping_Sec_3_3.verdict: The SET is reproduced exactly (6 of 6; the named six ARE the six largest bars, separated from the seventh by a factor of 1.33). The stated 5e4 THRESHOLD is not: DI-a3 reads 4.47e+04, 10.6% below it, which is ~13 px on a panel whose worst held-out tick residual is 0.48 px. Recorded in 08_contradictions.csv, not reconciled.

P3_fig4D_printed_liver_share._what: liver / sum(5 organ bars), against the percentage PRINTED on the pie chart the authors drew above each group. They never computed it from these bars, so it is external to this read; one misread bar breaks it.

stroke_centre_correction_px._why: bar_top returns the first row where the page ends, i.e. the stroke's upper half. The calibration is fitted on tick CENTROIDS. Reporting an edge against a centroid scale is F-019; every value below is at the stroke centre and this is the bias that removes.

P4_fig4B_geometry._unprinted_anchors: Two. (1) The drawn x-axis rule sits on a round 5,000 to 0.26 px -- a number the authors chose as an axis limit and never printed. (2) The minor ticks are equally spaced in LINEAR value inside each decade (2.8/4.6/6.4/8.2), so they are unequally spaced in the fitted log coordinate; a wrong scale cannot reproduce ten of them to 0.48 px by accident. Neither took part in the fit.

P7_already_merged_arm.claim: The in-vitro HepG2 arm of this paper is the SAME screen as corpus experiment YZ_2022 (PMID 35879315), which this paper cites as ref [16] for it.

step_1_corpus_vs_repo.join: on composition (helper, 4 component percents to 1 dp, N:P), using NO value column
step_1_corpus_vs_repo.reading: The residual IS the rounding in the deposited file. An exact-equality join therefore fails and is not the right test.

P7_already_merged_arm.verdict: ALREADY MERGED. Emitting these 192 values under a new Experiment_ID would duplicate a merged experiment and manufacture exactly the source-separability signal this project measures.

P8_corpus_positive_controls.asserts: the named helper DSPC, which this paper uses
THE ionizable lipid of this paper, by structure not by name

P9_C10_anchor.independence_guards: make_reference.py --selftest: control clean, 2 of 2 guard seeds credited (a forbidden import the AST sees and nothing executes, and a 40-character slice of the target pasted in as a literal).
P9_C10_anchor.vacuous_where_empty: Against the 7 empty anchors the guards are VACUOUS, not passing. Saying 'C10 clean' there would be F-013/F-037 exactly.

measured_sensitivity_limits.fig4B: 1 px = a factor of 1.0077. The worst held-out minor tick is 0.48 px = a factor of 1.0037, so a value is good to about 0.4%. The stroke-centre convention moves values by +0.54 px on average (a factor of 1.00418); reporting bar_top's row instead would bias every value high by that much.
measured_sensitivity_limits.fig4D: 1 px = a factor of 1.0209, three times coarser than Fig 4B. That the six printed liver shares still reproduce to 0.14 pp rms means the bars are being located to well under a pixel.
measured_sensitivity_limits.what_this_read_CANNOT_do: It cannot recover a dose that the panel does not state (Fig 4D and Fig 4C carry no dose), and it cannot distinguish a bar at the axis minimum from a bar below it -- though no bar in either panel sits on the baseline.
